sonnet.problem: The true/false statement holds two separate claims. The first sentence, 'Simeon and Levi are brothers, and Jacob has spoken about them together,' is a true fact. The second, 'Jacob says he will keep the two of them together in Israel,' is the false one. The baker has to mark both at once.
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.

sonnet.problem: The card quotes 'I await Your salvation, O LORD.' as an 'I' line but never names the speaker. It only says 'And here's the line:'. Card 5 is the only place Jacob is named as the one speaking.
sonnet.rule: When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first.
